Final for Publication

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
3363 South Morgan Street / 946-958 West 34" Street
From B1-2 to B2-3
The Property
The subject property is located in a B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District in an Equitable Transit Served Location
approximately 1,140 feet from the Halsted Street (Route 8) Corridor.

The property is improved with a five car garage.

The Project
Ivy Huang (the “Applicant”) proposes to redevelop the property into a four story mixed use building (approximately
59'-0" height) with ground-floor commercial space and six residential units. Two automobile parking spaces and two

bicycle spaces will be provided.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District to a B2-3 Neighborhood
Mixed-Use District.

The Applicant also is seeking all reliefas needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-l
application under section 17-13-0300(D) as follows: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A to obtain
relief under section 17-13-1003-EE(1) to reduce required automobile parking per section 17-10-0207-C for a property
located in a Transit Served Location to a qualifying bus corridor under section 17-10-0102-B(1)(a) from three parking
spaces (50%) to two spaces; 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A to obtain relief under section 17-13-
1003-GG to reduce bicycle parking reduction as required under section 17- 10-0102-B(2) from six to two spaces; 3) an
optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required 30’ rear yard setback required under section 17-
3-0405-A to 20.64’; 4) an optional variation under sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-L to increase the maximum
building height under section 17-3-0408 from 55° to 59'-0"; 5) an optional variation under sections 17-13-1101-A and
17-13-1003-Q to decrease the required transparency per section 17-3-0504-C from 97.20 square feet to 72.0 square
feet.

‘The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,900 square feet

Maximum FAR: 2.95

Floor Area: 11,498.07 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 6

MLA Density: 650 square feet

Height: 59°-0”

Bicycle Parking: 2*

Automobile Parking: 2m

Setbacks: Front (West/Morgan): zero
North: 3.0”
South: zero
Rear (East/alley): 30.0*

A set of plans is attached.

* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-1 3-0300(D).
